verdict.rationale: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs is a government company registry and filing portal, not a platform that hosts user-built automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The evidence pack shows only that robots.txt returns HTTP 403 on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing suggests the product ships any automation capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
